rng_note: Window start dates are drawn with random.Random seeded by sha256(rng_seed). Identical inputs reproduce identical windows; the seed and draw attempts are published per competition so the randomization is auditable.

scoring_policy.primary: accuracy (win rate on decided W/L selections), requires >= min_picks scored picks
scoring_policy.tiebreak: lower Brier score, then more picks, then username
scoring_policy.log_loss: pairwise on decided rows using each row's own selected-side probability
scoring_policy.pnl: summed only over VERIFIED_PRICE rows; null with an explicit pnl_status otherwise
scoring_policy.small_sample: postseason windows are tiny by construction; INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE applies — a standing is not an edge claim

disclaimer: SIMULATED paper competition. Standings are deterministic re-aggregations of the published backtest export inside randomized windows. No real-money wagers exist; a competition result is not a claim of a market edge.
